name: id
description: Unique row identifier (1..N)

name: small_int
description: Unsigned 8-bit integer in 0..255

name: medium_int
description: Unsigned 16-bit integer in 0..65535

name: big_int
description: Unsigned 32-bit integer up to ~4.29 billion

name: huge_int
description: Unsigned 64-bit integer for very large counts

name: measurement
description: Single-precision float; ~7 significant digits

name: precise_value
description: Double-precision float; ~15 significant digits

name: maybe_flag
description: Tri-state flag (null/true/false) packed into one bit

name: small_grade
description: 4-bit grade in 0..14, value 15 reserved as null

name: maybe_age
description: 8-bit age in years; 0xFF reserved as null sentinel

name: maybe_count
description: 16-bit count; 0xFFFF reserved as null sentinel

name: event_date
description: Calendar date stored as days since the Unix epoch

name: active
description: Bit-packed boolean activity flag (no null support)

name: region
description: Coarse region label (north/south/east/west)

name: city
description: City of origin; mid-cardinality categorical

name: sku
description: SKU identifier; high-cardinality categorical

name: amount
description: Monetary amount in USD with two decimal places of precision

name: precise_amount
description: High-precision amount with six decimals; null sentinel reserved

name: location
description: Packed (lat, lon) f64 pair for spatial filters and centroids

name: cell
description: Uber H3 cell index at native resolution 9
